decision.summary: The emailed bank change for Margaret Ellison (L-02) came from a lookalike domain with a protonmail Reply-To and urgent, no-call wording, so it fails the fraud policy's call-back requirement. I did not change bank details, held payments to the requested account (HOLD-101), escalated to fraud (ESC-102), and emailed the landlord on her on-file address that no change has been made.

answers.question: 1. Should the bank details be changed? What evidence did you use?
answers.answer: No, not on this email. The sender address (margaret@ellisonletings.co.uk) differs from the on-file address (margaret@ellisonlettings.co.uk, CRM and her 22 Sep email). The Reply-To is a protonmail address, the request is urgent, and it asks us to confirm by email only. Fraud policy requires a phone call-back to the number on file (+447700900202) and dual approval. Neither has happened.

answers.question: 2. What happens to the payout scheduled for Monday?
answers.answer: The 12 Oct GBP 1,932.00 payout should not go to the requested account (sort 00-99-01, account 31926819). It stays on the existing account ending 9902 unless the call-back and dual approval verify a change. Payment to the new details is on hold (HOLD-101). Fraud team to decide before the 09:00 run.

answers.question: 3. Who do you contact and through which channel?
answers.answer: The landlord, by phone on the number on file (+447700900202) to verify the request. This call has not been made yet, so it is an open action for the fraud team. Separately, I emailed the landlord on her on-file address to say no change has been made (MSG-103). I did not use any contact from the suspicious email.

args.body:
Dear Margaret,

We received an email today (9 October, 15:12) asking us to change the bank account for your rent income. We have not made any change. For your security, we can only change bank details after speaking to you on the phone number we hold for you, so we will be in touch that way. Your payments will continue to go to your existing account until then.

If you did not send this request, please let us know straight away.

Kind regards
Lettings team
